values.event_label: "Adjustments for v1.5.0-alpha.6 specs": moves the deposit, withdrawal and consolidation request lists out of StableExecutionPayload / StableExecutionPayloadHeader into a new StableExecutionRequests container with the new capacity MAX_EXECUTION_REQUESTS_FIELDS (16); adds execution_requests to StableBeaconBlockBody and an ExecutionRequests Profile.
values.rationale: Relocates fields between containers and adds a new container with its own capacity; changes merkleization and generalized indices.

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: Renames PendingBalanceDeposit -> PendingDeposit, the BeaconState field pending_balance_deposits -> pending_deposits and the limit PENDING_BALANCE_DEPOSITS_LIMIT -> PENDING_DEPOSITS_LIMIT, tracking the upstream consensus-specs rename; bumps all consensus-specs links (commit subject is "Update EIP-7495: ...", a multi-EIP change that also touched this file).
values.rationale: Field names in a StableContainer are permanent identifiers under this EIP's own immutability rule, so renaming one is a change to the normative data structure, not merely editorial.

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: Bumps every consensus-specs permalink from commit c1e509b0 to the tagged beta version b3e83f66 (38 link-only replacements); no prose or type definition changed.
values.rationale: Link-target-only change.
values.source_title: Update EIP-6404: Bump links to tagged beta spec version

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: Status frontmatter changed back from Review to Draft (commit subject "Update EIP-7495: Move to Draft"; the dependency's status move propagated to this file).
values.rationale: Process-metadata-only change.

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Adopt ProgressiveContainer / ProgressiveList": wholesale redesign replacing StableContainer/Profile with EIP-7495 ProgressiveContainer(active_fields=[...]) plus EIP-7916 ProgressiveList / ProgressiveBitlist; deletes the capacity constants table, the fork-agnostic StableContainer definitions and the fork-specific Profile definitions; introduces a "Converted types" list naming the types and fields to convert; adds active_fields evolution rules (append trailing 1, zero a removed field's bit, CompatibleUnion tests); adds requires 7916 and changes the description to "...to ProgressiveContainer"; adds a cleanup-opportunities section.
values.rationale: Replaces the underlying SSZ mechanism, the merkleization scheme and the entire specification structure; the largest normative change in the EIP's history (102 insertions / 230 deletions).

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: Corrects the declaration notation from ProgressiveContainer[active_fields=[...]] to ProgressiveContainer(active_fields=[...]) in the rule and the example (valid Python call syntax); commit subject is "Update EIP-6404: ...", a multi-EIP change that also touched this file.
values.rationale: Notation-only correction; the same active_fields semantics and the same converted types are specified before and after.
values.source_title: Update EIP-6404: Use correct Python syntax for active_fields

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Also make committee bits progressive": adds Attestation.committee_bits to the converted list, redefining it to use ProgressiveBitlist.
values.rationale: Adds a field to the normative conversion list, changing Attestation merkleization.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Also make committee bits progressive

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Move committee_bits to cleanup opportunities": reverses the previous day's change by removing committee_bits from the normative converted list and recording it instead as a non-normative cleanup opportunity (Bitvector whose top bits are forced to zero); also restructures the cleanup section into per-type subsections.
values.rationale: Removes a field from the normative conversion list, reverting the merkleization change introduced by commit 89d746cc; same logical update.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Move committee_bits to cleanup opportunities

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: Adds an IndexedAttestation subsection to the (explicitly non-normative) "Cleanup opportunities" rationale, discussing attesting_indices limits versus SingleAttestation traffic, MAX_ATTESTER_SLASHINGS_ELECTRA, and possible shared resource-based limits.
values.rationale: Forward-looking discussion added to the Rationale section only; no requirement, type or field is changed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Add IndexedAttestation as cleanup opportunity

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Add notes for ExecutionPayload and ExecutionRequests": removes ExecutionPayloadHeader from the converted-types list; records that the MAX_TRANSACTIONS_PER_PAYLOAD (1M) limit is no longer enforced; adds ExecutionPayload and ExecutionRequests cleanup subsections; rewords the BeaconBlockHeader and Validator items to state they are proposed to be kept as is.
values.rationale: Changes which types are converted (ExecutionPayloadHeader dropped) and states that a previously enforced list limit no longer applies.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Add notes for ExecutionPayload and ExecutionRequests

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Add security considerations and add blob lists": replaces "Security Considerations: None" with a three-paragraph analysis (loss of fixed upper bounds with ProgressiveList, length checks moved to gossip validation and state transition, libp2p decrypt/decompress/hash pipeline under MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE, and the argument that DoS exposure does not materially increase); simultaneously moves blob_kzg_commitments out of the BeaconBlockBody bullet into a separate bullet that also converts kzg_proofs and column to ProgressiveList.
values.rationale: Introduces the EIP's security analysis where none existed and, in the same commit, extends the set of progressive-list fields; classified by the dominant security-assumption effect with the data-structure change recorded in the summary.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Add security considerations and add blob lists

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures

values.rationale: Corrects an attribution inside the non-normative cleanup section; EIP-6110 was already a declared frontmatter dependency, so the dependency set is unchanged.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Refer to correct EIP for 6110 refs

values.event_label: "Fix field naming and wording": corrects the ExecutionRequests bullet from the field name "consolidation" to "consolidations" (matching the consensus-specs field), and fixes "as is breaks" -> "as it breaks" in the BeaconBlockHeader cleanup paragraph.
values.rationale: The field-name correction is inside the normative converted-types list and identifies which ExecutionRequests field becomes a ProgressiveList; classified substantive on that basis, with the grammar fix incidental.

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Make Transaction progressive": Transaction is redefined as ProgressiveByteList and removed from the immutable-types table; the MAX_BYTES_PER_TRANSACTION (1 GB) limit is no longer enforced; the parenthetical justifying the unenforced MAX_TRANSACTIONS_PER_PAYLOAD limit via MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE is dropped.
values.rationale: Moves a type from the immutable set into the converted set, changing its merkleization and removing an enforced size bound.

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Suggest constants for network message size bounds": adds a new specification section requiring (SHOULD) a constant per affected libp2p gossip topic and req/resp chunk type giving its maximum uncompressed serialized size derived from the pre-conversion capacity, with MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE as the fallback for variable-size messages; rewrites Security Considerations to state that serialization and libp2p limits are unchanged and early-reject behavior is preserved by the new constants; adds "Only merkleization changes; serialization of affected types is unchanged" to the abstract; bumps consensus-specs links to 932c6d69.
values.rationale: Adds a new normative requirement covering p2p message bounds and replaces the previous security argument that no such bounds existed.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Suggest constants for network message size bounds

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Add rationale for Validator remaining Container": restores ExecutionPayloadHeader to the converted-types list; revises the immutable-types table (adds SignedBeaconBlockHeader, ParticipationFlags, SyncCommittee, AttesterSlashing, reorders entries, moves KZGCommitment to the deneb polynomial-commitments path, fixes the ConsolidationRequest anchor and the #custom-types -> #types anchors); adds a "Validator container" rationale explaining why Validator stays a Container; removes the "Best timing?" and "Can this be applied retroactively?" sections, folding the latter into a "Retroactive application" section.
values.rationale: Changes both the converted-types set and the immutable-types set, which together determine the merkleization of the affected structures.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Add rationale for Validator remaining Container

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Resolve the 'cleanup opportunities' section": deletes the entire cleanup opportunities section (BeaconState, Attestation, IndexedAttestation, ExecutionPayload, ExecutionRequests, BeaconBlockHeader - including the in-text EIP-6110 link) and replaces it with a "History accumulators" rationale stating that historical_roots and historical_summaries are deliberately kept as List types; adds a Motivation paragraph on decoupling operational limits from the SSZ schema; rewords the list-conversion and immutable-types paragraphs.
values.rationale: Beyond removing non-normative discussion, it states positively which accumulators are deliberately not converted, which resolves previously open scope for implementers; classified substantive on that basis.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Resolve the 'cleanup opportunities' section

values.eip_label: EIP-7688 · Forward compatible consensus data structures
values.event_label: "Improve wording / address nits": lifts "The application logic SHALL be updated to check for an appropriate limit at runtime" out of the ProgressiveList bullet into a standalone sentence so it now covers both the List and Bitlist conversions; adds an Electra example to the append-only immutability rationale; changes "since Phase 0" to "since genesis"; links the gossipsub message rejection behavior; various wording nits in Motivation, History accumulators, Backwards Compatibility and Security Considerations.
values.rationale: Broadens the scope of a SHALL requirement from one conversion rule to both; the remaining changes are wording.
values.source_title: Update EIP-7688: Improve wording / address nits

values.rationale: Commit e338bc94 (PR #11853) removed the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading, leaving the whole CFI list rendered under the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' heading. values.eip_label: EIP-7732 · Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation
values.event_label: Resynchronises the EIP with the consensus-specs design, repinning the six links to consensus-specs 9e2dc0bcf9aa17b549e1df4712b16a5709d74119 and rewriting the summary. The builder payment becomes an execution-layer withdrawal to a proposer-chosen address rather than a direct beacon-balance credit; PTC attestations also cover blob data availability. PAYLOAD_ABSENT/PRESENT/WITHHELD/INVALID_STATUS are dropped and PayloadAttestationData's uint8 payload_status becomes the booleans payload_present and blob_data_available; new BuilderPendingPayment and BuilderPendingWithdrawal containers, the BUILDER_PEDING_WITHDRAWALS_LIMIT (sic) preset of 2**20 and BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX 0x03 are added; ExecutionPayloadEnvelope gains execution_requests and slot; BeaconState gains execution_payload_availability, builder_pending_payments and builder_pending_withdrawals and loses latest_full_slot; process_execution_payload_header now queues a pending payment; a new epoch-processing helper process_builder_pending_payments is added; the unused AttestationData 'index' field is repurposed to signal payload availability. Fork choice is restructured: INTERVALS_PER_SLOT, PROPOSER_SCORE_BOOST, PAYLOAD_WITHHOLD_BOOST and PAYLOAD_REVEAL_BOOST are removed in favour of PAYLOAD_STATUS_PENDING/EMPTY/FULL, ChildNode becomes ForkChoiceNode, LatestMessage gains payload_present, the Store loses the withhold/reveal boost fields, and the 'Builder timeliness boosts' rationale and the 'Reorg resistance' security section are deleted. The inclusion-list compatibility reference changes from EIP-7547 to EIP-7805.
values.rationale: Changes constants, container definitions, state fields, state-transition and fork-choice rules, the payment mechanism and the stated security properties. Substantive by every clause of the rubric, and the commit that also replaces one explicit cross-EIP reference with another.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 105ac0656c09: Update EIP-7732: update to latest CL-spec version

values.eip_label: EIP-7732 · Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation
values.event_label: Second full resynchronisation, this time against the Gloas specs: the six links move to consensus-specs c94138e73e0e70eb4b27f9be4d4e9325fa1aebf7 and from specs/_features/eip7732/ to specs/gloas/. Builders become a distinct in-protocol entity rather than an attribution of validators - a new BuilderIndex type, BUILDER_INDEX_FLAG, BUILDER_INDEX_SELF_BUILD, a Builder container and a builders registry with BUILDER_REGISTRY_LIMIT, MAX_BUILDERS_PER_WITHDRAWALS_SWEEP, MIN_BUILDER_WITHDRAWABILITY_DELAY and the BUILDER_PAYMENT_THRESHOLD numerator/denominator - and the Abstract records that builder stake is not actively validating, is exempt from the churn queues, can be as little as 1 ETH, and that trusted 'promise' payments are accommodated. SignedExecutionPayloadHeader is renamed SignedExecutionPayloadBid with a new ExecutionPayloadBid container; DOMAIN_BEACON_BUILDER changes from 0x1B000000 to 0x0B000000 and DOMAIN_PROPOSER_PREFERENCES 0x0D000000 is added; full BeaconBlockBody and BeaconState listings replace the prose deltas, with latest_withdrawals_root replaced by payload_expected_withdrawals and next_withdrawal_builder_index added; ExecutionPayloadEnvelope drops blob_kzg_commitments and payload_withheld; builder deposits with the builder withdrawal prefix are processed immediately; the fork-choice section is reduced to a one-line statement that forkchoice is changed substantially; a ProposerPreferences p2p topic is added; and a 'Free option problem' security section is added. Justin Traglia is added as an author.
values.rationale: Changes types, containers, domain constants, the builder model, the withdrawal flow, the p2p topic set and the security analysis. Substantive, and the version of the specification that stands at the pinned repository commit.
values.source_title: ethereum/EIPs commit 4d7af9552eda: Update EIP-7732: update consensus links

values.eip_label: EIP-8045 · Exclude slashed validators from proposing
values.rationale: Commit e338bc94 (PR #11853) removed the 'Considered for Inclusion' heading, leaving the whole CFI list rendered under the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' heading. The PR body describes its intent as a stage restructuring that adds EIP-8282 and EIP-7610 to Considered for Inclusion, and the same-day correction PR #11917 states the changes 'were not completely correct'. Three days later the ACDE #241 call (2026-07-16) recorded that Glamsterdam EIPs were 'not yet moved to SFI' (ACDbot summary, 00:25:12), confirming no scheduling decision existed on 2026-07-13, so the apparent SFI placement is treated as an editorial error and normalized to unknown rather than scheduled_for_inclusion.

values.event_label: Major respecification (PR #10765, 181 insertions / 60 deletions): retitles to 'Increase exit and consolidation churn'; reinstates the activation cap as MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT = 2**8, replacing MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_EXIT_CHURN_LIMIT; splits get_activation_exit_churn_limit into a capped get_activation_churn_limit and an uncapped get_exit_churn_limit; replaces get_balance_churn_limit with a rewritten compute_weak_subjectivity_period that weights exit churn 2/3, activation churn 1/3 and consolidation churn 1; routes exits through the consolidation queue whenever earliest_exit_epoch > earliest_consolidation_epoch using compute_consolidation_epoch_and_update_churn with 2 * exit_balance // 3; and adds full process_pending_deposits and compute_exit_epoch_and_update_churn listings plus reworked rationale and weak-subjectivity figures (~7 days). Introduces an [EIP-8071] reference.
values.rationale: Wholesale change of the specified constants, churn functions, exit routing and weak-subjectivity formula.
values.source_title: Update EIP-8061: bring back deposit cap and let exits use the consolidation queue

values.eip_label: EIP-8061 · Increase exit and consolidation churn
values.event_label: Removes the exits-use-consolidation-queue mechanism (PR #10860, 'remove the overlap with EIP-8080'): compute_exit_epoch_and_update_churn no longer redirects to compute_consolidation_epoch_and_update_churn, the corresponding Abstract sentence, Motivation bullet (which carried the only [EIP-8071] reference), Rationale bullet and 'Can also be used by exits' docstring line are deleted; also fixes compute_weak_subjectivity_period to call get_exit_churn_limit instead of the removed get_activation_exit_churn_limit, and rewrites a Motivation sentence about which stakers benefit from illiquidity.
values.rationale: Removes a specified state-transition behavior and corrects a function call in the weak-subjectivity computation; directly implementation-visible.
values.source_title: Update EIP-8061: remove the overlap with EIP-8080

values.eip_label: EIP-8061 · Increase exit and consolidation churn
values.event_label: Frontmatter status Draft to Review and requires changed from 7521 to 7251 (PR #11887); also deletes the empty 'Test Cases / TODO' section.
values.rationale: Corrects the declared prerequisite. EIPS/eip-7521.md is an ERC that was moved out of the EIPs repository and is unrelated to churn, so 'requires: 7521' was an error; EIP-7251 introduced consolidations and the exit cap this EIP modifies and was already referenced in the prose. Changing the declared dependency set is treated as substantive.

values.event_label: Sync with the Gloas consensus-specs (PR #11859): BUILDER_WITHDRAWAL_PREFIX changes from 0x03 to 0xB0 in all five places it appears; the placeholder predeploy addresses change from 0x...7732/0x...7733 to 0x...01008282/0x...02008282; the placeholder markers on the request-type bytes are dropped; the SSZ containers change base class from object to Container; and the exited-builder top-up rule is tightened so withdrawable_epoch is re-armed only when the exited entry has already swept to zero (withdrawable_epoch != FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH and balance == 0) rather than on every top-up.
values.rationale: Changes a credential prefix constant, the declared predeploy addresses, an SSZ container declaration and a consensus-layer state-transition condition; all are implementation- and test-visible.
values.source_title: Update EIP-8282: Sync with gloas spec

values.eip_label: EIP-8282 · Builder Execution Requests
values.event_label: Fixes the predeploy addresses to values derived from the current reference bytecode (PR #11899): BUILDER_DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS becomes 0x0000bFF46984e3725691FA540a8C7589300D8282 and BUILDER_EXIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS becomes 0x000064D678505ad48F8cCb093BC65613800E8282, both without placeholder markers; the Deployment paragraph is restated to say the addresses derive from the presigned deployment transactions for the current reference bytecode and will change if that bytecode changes.
values.rationale: Replaces placeholder constants with concrete addresses that implementations and tests must use.
values.source_title: Update EIP-8282: set predeploy addresses from current reference bytecode

values.eip_label: EIP-8282 · Builder Execution Requests
values.event_label: Frontmatter status Draft to Review (PR #12108); removes the parenthetical stating that EIP-7804, a Draft, also claims request type 0x03, leaving only 'The 0x03/0x04 request types MUST be unique across all active EIP-7685 request types; final allocation is coordinated in consensus-specs'; and empties the Reference Implementation TODO comment.
values.rationale: Removes the EIP's only explicit statement of a request-type-byte conflict with another in-flight proposal, changing its declared cross-EIP reference set; the normative uniqueness requirement itself is retained. Medium confidence because the status move and comment removal alone would be non_substantive and the dropped text was a coordination note rather than a rule.

values.eip_label: EIP-8282 · Builder Execution Requests
values.event_label: Cleanup and tweaks rewrite (PR #11869, 93 insertions / 72 deletions): adds Felix Lange as an author; replaces Nick's-method presigned deployment with deployment through the EIP-7997 CREATE2 factory using a mined salt; removes the EXCESS_INHIBITOR constant and its deployment-time inhibitor semantics; restructures the request-queue section into Write path / Fee getter / System call and adds that a SYSTEM_ADDRESS call carrying calldata permanently disables the queue via an inhibitor and that non-matching calls MUST revert; states that both contracts apply fee increases per write rather than at end of block, unlike EIP-7002; moves the request-type uniqueness statement below the constants table with a consensus-specs permalink; simplifies the deposit acceptance condition to msg.value >= amount * 1 gwei + fee; fills in Reference Implementation with ethereum/sys-asm links; and condenses Motivation, Rationale, Backwards Compatibility and Security Considerations into headed subsections.
values.rationale: Changes the deployment mechanism, removes a constant, adds new system-call and revert rules and changes when the fee is updated; all are implementation- and test-visible.
